purpose: Teach: ヒューマン/ギア/タブー/シアトル/ロサンゼルス/スターリン/麻雀/アクティブ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの会社はヒューマンな職場らしいわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's company sounds like a pretty human place to work.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Gentle cadence, as if sharing something she's learned. Slight upward lift at the end — offering it to him, not imposing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと自転車のギア、いじったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I took apart the bike gears together.
lines.style: Bright, proud energy. Quick, eager tempo. Small lift of accomplishment in his voice. Wants her to know he did something with Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご家庭でのタブーって意外と多いのよ
lines.en: Sho, there are more rules about what you can do at home than you'd think.
lines.style: Gentle warning-tone, not stern. Measured pace. She's pointing something out he'll understand later. Slight pause before the second clause.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが、シアトルに留学してたんだって
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me he studied abroad in Seattle.
lines.style: Curious, half-processing. Soft energy — he's turning this new information over in his mind. Slight trailing-off, like he's waiting for her to help him understand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ロサンゼルスは温かい街らしいわね
lines.en: Sho, Los Angeles is supposed to be such a warm city.
lines.style: Wistful, conversational. She's thinking out loud a little. Warm but distant tone, like she's briefly somewhere else. Slight dreaminess at the edges.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんがスターリン時代の話を聞かせてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa told me stories about the Stalin era.
lines.style: Quiet, serious-toned. He's holding what he heard carefully. Slower pace than his excited moments. A little wonder underneath the sobriety.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんは麻雀の名人らしいわよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is supposed to be quite the mahjong master.
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone. Light, almost playful cadence. Pride in her father-in-law showing through. Gentle smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お休みの日もアクティブに過ごしたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to spend my days off doing active things.
lines.style: Earnest, hopeful energy. Clear and direct — he knows what he wants. Bright finish, looking toward her for agreement or understanding.
